dataset: Existing complete predeclared UA-DETRAC test sequences; shared historical holdout, not a new independent split

adaptive.skipped_output: previous measured boxes; no invented optical trajectories

promotion: No automatic promotion. Compare accuracy, continuous-event utility and CPU cost; retain original pipeline by default.
limitations: Three research cameras, not independent five-city labels
No surveyed physical queue or turn ground truth
Host wall timing may share CPU with other work; process CPU time is also measured
Adaptive held boxes are stale by at most one 25-FPS frame, explicitly recorded
